guide.summary: Clear water rich in silicate, with two upright strips of mesh, one each side of the centre.
guide.biology: Dissolved silicate is the raw material some small life uses to build glassy shells.
guide.rules: All water; no stones. Silicate 0.30 in every cell. Light 0.8, warmth 0.5, oxygen 0.8, carbon dioxide 0.5, nutrient 0.10 and sugar 0.02 in every cell. Attachment mesh in two strips at x 40 and x 88 from y 35 to 90. Lid open; fixed light.
guide.example: Follow the silicate overlay as life in the dish draws it down.
